back_translation: Ah, land of loudly whirring wings, which lies beyond the rivers of Cush,

which sends envoys by sea, in papyrus-reed boats over the surface of the water. Go, swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth-skinned, to a nation dreaded near and far, a nation strong and conquering everywhere, whose land many rivers flow through.
All you inhabitants of the world and dwellers on the earth: when a signal banner is raised on the mountains, look! And when the horn is blown, listen!
For the LORD has said to me: "I will stay quietly still and watch from My dwelling place, like shimmering sun-haze above the sunlight, like a mist of dew in the heat of harvest season."

For before the harvest arrives, when the blossom has fallen and the flower is becoming a ripening grape, He will cut off the tendril-shoots with pruning knives and remove the sprawling branches, cutting them away.

They will all be left to the birds of prey of the mountains and to the wild beasts of the earth; the birds of prey will feed on them all summer, and all the wild beasts of the earth will feed on them all winter.

At that time, tribute will be brought as an offering to the LORD of Hosts from a nation tall and smooth-skinned, from a nation dreaded near and far, a nation strong and conquering everywhere, whose land many rivers flow through — to the place of the Name of the LORD of Hosts, Mount Zion.
